name: Attack
description: Make one melee or ranged attack with a weapon or unarmed strike. Class features and feats may grant additional attacks (Extra Attack at fighter level 5, etc.).

name: Dash
description: Gain extra movement equal to your Speed for the turn. Any increases or decreases to Speed (e.g. difficult terrain) apply to this extra movement.

name: Disengage
description: Your movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks for the rest of the turn.

name: Dodge
description: Until the start of your next turn, attack rolls against you have Disadvantage if you can see the attacker, and you have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws. Lost if you become Incapacitated or your Speed becomes 0.

name: Help
description: Either aid an ally with their next ability check (you grant Advantage if it's an ability check made within 1 minute) or aid an ally's first attack against a target within 5 feet of you (Advantage before the start of your next turn).

name: Hide
description: Make a Dexterity (Stealth) check while you have full cover or are heavily obscured. On a success, you have the Invisible condition until you make noise, attack, or are otherwise revealed.

name: Magic
description: Cast a spell with a casting time of an Action, or activate a magic item that requires a Magic action. (Renamed from 'Cast a Spell' in the 2024 SRD, but conceptually identical.)

name: Cast a Spell
description: Cast a spell with a casting time of 1 action. Different casting times (Bonus Action, Reaction, longer rituals) use their respective slots.

name: Ready
description: Prepare a single action (or readied movement) and a trigger. When the trigger occurs before the start of your next turn, you can spend your Reaction to take the readied action.

name: Search
description: Make a Wisdom (Perception), Intelligence (Investigation), or Wisdom (Insight) check to find or notice something hidden in your immediate surroundings.

name: Influence
description: 2024-only: Make a Charisma check (Persuasion, Intimidation, Deception, or Performance) to convince a creature within 30 feet to do something. Doesn't work on creatures hostile to you in combat.

name: Study
description: 2024-only: Make an Intelligence check (Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, or Religion) to recall lore about something you can perceive within 10 feet.

name: Utilize
description: 2024-only: Use a non-magical object that requires more than the free Object Interaction (e.g. tying knots, pouring liquid carefully). The 5.1 equivalent was 'Use an Object'.

name: Use an Object
description: Use a non-magical object that requires action — e.g. open a heavy door, tie knots, smash a vial. The 2024 successor is 'Utilize'.

name: Opportunity Attack
description: When a creature you can see leaves your reach, you can spend your Reaction to make one melee attack against it (with the weapon you have in hand or an unarmed strike).
